en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,

‘I asked himasws about the Salāt by the night and the day, when neither the sun, nor the moon, nor the stars can be seen. Heasws said: ‘Strive your view and deliberate your struggle for (finding) the Qiblah’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah, who has said the following:

“I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about performing Salah (prayer) during the night and during the day when the sun, the moon and stars cannot be seen. He (the Imam) said, ‘ Strive to come up with your best opinion about al-Qiblah (al-Ka‘bah).’”
